agent_evaluations.detailed_comments: This OSCE content fails radiology interpretation standards due to critical gaps: (1) No actual diagnostic images - all are placeholders, making stations unexaminable; (2) No systematic interpretation frameworks demonstrated in expected answers; (3) Generic clinical vignettes lacking specific details needed for realistic diagnostic reasoning; (4) Vital signs not tailored to conditions (e.g., bradycardia station shows HR 88 bpm); (5) Missing Australian radiological terminology and RANZCR standards in marking criteria. While the structural framework (JSON format, RAG citations, task allocation) is sound, the clinical content requires complete redevelopment with real images and expert-validated systematic interpretations before deployment. This content would not meet AMC Clinical Examination standards for imaging stations.
agent_evaluations.estimated_revision_effort: High - Requires acquisition of 91 real diagnostic images, rewriting all 50 clinical vignettes, creating detailed systematic interpretation examples, and expert radiologist validation

agent_evaluations.medication_expert_notes: This OSCE is a template-generated placeholder with zero clinical content relevant to medication management evaluation. It cannot be assessed for Australian drug nomenclature, PBS compliance, dosing accuracy, or drug interactions as it contains no actual medication information. The scenario describes bradycardia but provides vital signs showing HR 88 bpm (normal, not bradycardic). This is unsuitable for AMC Clinical Examination use without complete rewrite to include: (1) specific patient history with current medications, (2) medication-induced bradycardia assessment, (3) Australian guideline-based emergency management with correct drug names and doses, (4) PBS-compliant prescribing, (5) STOPP/START criteria application for elderly patients. Current content quality: 0/10. Requires complete regeneration with LLM using RAG-validated Australian cardiology guidelines.
